name: Victorian water and sewerage concession
provider: Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
summary: 50% off water and sewerage charges, up to a yearly cap, for Victorian water account holders with a Health Care Card.
key: 50% deduction on water and sewerage charges up to a yearly maximum of $372.10 for 2025-26.
who: Water account holder with a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card or Veterans' Affairs Gold Card
how: Phone your water corporation and give your concession card details over the phone.
catches: The page shows the 2025-26 cap; the 2026-27 cap was not yet listed when checked.
